name: AI Anthropic Provider (OAuth)
description: Registers an 'anthropic_oauth' AI provider that talks to the Anthropic Messages API with a long-lived 'claude setup-token' Bearer token stored via the Key module, instead of an official API key.
project_description: Registers an AI-module chat provider (plugin id 'anthropic_oauth', label 'Anthropic (OAuth Token)') that authenticates to the native Anthropic Messages API (https://api.anthropic.com/v1) with a long-lived setup-token generated by the 'claude setup-token' CLI command (prefix sk-ant-oat01-, valid ~1 year, no refresh flow). The token is stored through the Key module and only the Key entity id is saved in module config. The provider supports the 'chat' operation type, converts between the Drupal AI module's ChatInput/ChatMessage types and Anthropic's message/tool format, injects a required Claude Code identity system prompt plus the claude-code / oauth beta headers so Sonnet and Opus models are reachable with setup-tokens, discovers models from GET /v1/models with a hardcoded fallback list, and optionally wires up OpenAI external moderation. The module's own settings form warns that using setup-tokens in third-party applications may violate Anthropic's Terms of Service and recommends ai_provider_anthropic with official API keys for production; it is intended for development, testing, and internal use with a Claude Pro/Max/Team subscription.
